meta.source_provenance: Email from Ben Carter to PC Jon Dixon on 7 Nov 2024 at 19:19 (provided by user)

emails.subject_summary: Query about re-uploading evidence via Google Drive due to NICE link limit
emails.body: How can I re-upload anything? I had over 100 screenshots and videos but it had a limit, would a Google Drive link be alright if I sent you the link?

sentence_tags.notes: Ben signals issue with existing system.

contradiction_links.claim: Police systems were adequate to receive all victim evidence.
contradiction_links.reality: Victim highlights NICE link upload limit after attempting to send 100+ items; suggests workaround.
laws_breached: Victims’ Code 2020 (Right to supply evidence without obstruction)

events: Ben reports hitting NICE link upload limits with 100+ screenshots/videos.
Asks if Google Drive link can be used to share remaining evidence.
